location: Halvor's compound, at the warehouse door
body: You entered Ironhold at midday, delivered Brenna's caravan for twenty-five gold apiece, and took rooms at the Grey Kettle in the Merchants' Quarter — where Orin charmed Mother Hessa into bed and Torren quietly showed her the Veil mark. That night, instead of waiting for dawn, you crossed the city to Halvor's compound. Sylas conjured a Fey familiar in the alley behind the warehouse. You are standing at the back door with the chain and the padlock between you and Mira.
